name: Silithid Egg (The Barrens)
summary: Across the Field of Giants, silithid eggs lie buried beneath the soil. Horde researchers gather them to learn about the swarm spreading through the southern Barrens.

sections.title: A Mysterious Swarm
sections.body: Silithid mounds rise from the Field of Giants as strange insect-like creatures churn the earth. Their eggs lie beneath the hardened soil, guarded by territorial silithid. The Horde knows little about these creatures, but scouts at the Crossroads have seen signs of coordination and intelligence beyond that of ordinary wild beasts. Unhatched eggs may help scholars in Orgrimmar learn about the silithid’s life cycle and nature.

sections.title: Excavation and Danger
sections.body: Silithid eggs must be dug from the mounds with an adapted digging claw. The creatures defend their underground nurseries fiercely, swarming anyone who threatens their unhatched young. Korran, a troll researcher, needs intact specimens for study before the swarm spreads farther across Kalimdor.

faq.answer: Silithid Eggs are unhatched clutches buried in earthen mounds in the southern Barrens, especially around the Field of Giants.
Korran, a troll researcher at the Crossroads, gathers the eggs for his masters in Orgrimmar, who want to study silithid biology and behavior.

faq.q: Why are the silithid being studied?
faq.answer: The Horde knows little about the silithid. Korran has seen signs of intelligence and coordination beyond those of typical wild animals, troubling Horde leaders as the creatures appear in the Barrens.
An adapted digging claw is used to pry eggs from silithid mounds, while the aggressive swarm defends its nests.

angles.text: For the Horde, intelligent insect swarms near the Crossroads threaten trade routes and territory in central Kalimdor.
